diagnostic_only_findings: The v1 rolling median absolute H-second return can be zero in a sparse 1-second last-trade series, producing infinite z-scores.
Most unconditional beta-implied ETH responses are much smaller than realistic round-trip costs; the signal therefore requires an explicit ex-ante residual-gap floor.

candidate_selection.fit_use: Formula diagnostics and causal implementation verification only; final candidate selection is performed on the two development dates under the frozen gate.
candidate_selection.if_no_development_survivor: Stop and report the information unit below gate. Do not open the two frozen validation dates or any 2024+ data.
candidate_selection.primary_choice: Among gate survivors maximize min(mean net return at 24bp, top-10%-winner-removed mean net return at 12bp). Ties prefer more trades, shorter leader horizon, larger residual-gap floor, lower z threshold, then lexical candidate id.

economic_mechanism: A completed BTC aggressive-flow shock can reveal common information before ETH fully incorporates its prior-only beta-implied response.

The trade is admissible only when BTC price and aggressive flow agree, BTC activity is abnormal, ETH flow is not already aligned strongly, and the direction-aligned residual gap itself is large enough to exceed realistic costs.
The strategy monetizes causal residual closure, not unconditional correlation or a fixed elapsed-time markout.

event_definition.activity_baseline: For each H, median of prior H-second BTC quote-notional windows ending at one-second boundaries during the 900 seconds strictly before shock start; require at least 300 finite positive windows.
event_definition.beta_estimator: OLS slope cov(BTC_1s,ETH_1s)/var(BTC_1s) on the 1800 one-second returns strictly before shock start; require at least 1200 finite pairs and at least 100 nonzero BTC returns.
event_definition.event_cooldown: After one detected shock for a candidate, suppress new signals until direction-aligned BTC displacement from that shock start falls below 25% of its decision displacement or changes sign.
event_definition.scale_estimator: Prior-only realized H-second volatility: sqrt(H/900 * sum of squared finite one-second BTC log returns over the 900 seconds strictly before shock start); require at least 600 finite returns and at least 60 nonzero returns; no zero-scale substitution.

execution_and_exit.catchup_target: At decision freeze target log price = ETH log price at shock start + catchup_fraction * beta * BTC shock return. If the first executable ETH trade after latency is already at or beyond the target, no position is opened.
execution_and_exit.impulse_decay_exit: Exit at the first executable ETH trade after BTC direction-aligned displacement from shock start is <=25% of decision displacement for ten consecutive valid 100ms states.
execution_and_exit.opposite_shock_exit: Exit at the first executable ETH trade after a completed opposite BTC 1-second shock with prior-scaled absolute z >=3 and aligned BTC aggressive imbalance >=0.5.
execution_and_exit.structural_stop: At decision freeze stop distance = max(10bp, 0.75 * direction-aligned residual gap). Exit at the first actual ETH trade after the direction-aligned entry-to-current log return reaches the negative stop distance; gap-through uses that first actual trade without capping.
execution_and_exit.unresolved_day_boundary: A position still open at source end is an unresolved failed path and cannot promote; it is never force-closed at a favorable terminal mark.

feature_formula.btc_flow_alignment: d * signed BTC quote notional / total BTC quote notional over the completed H-second window.
feature_formula.btc_return: log(BTC decision mark / BTC shock-start mark).
feature_formula.eth_flow_alignment: d * signed ETH quote notional / total ETH quote notional over the same completed H-second window.
feature_formula.eth_return: log(ETH decision mark / ETH shock-start mark).
feature_formula.underreaction_ratio: d * ETH return / abs(beta * BTC return).

information_contract.decision: Only after the full BTC leader horizon and contemporaneous ETH horizon have completed.
information_contract.entry: First actual ETHUSDT public trade at or after decision timestamp plus 100ms.
information_contract.missing_data: No time compression and no interpolation across stale state. Feature marks may carry only the last causal public trade for at most 2000ms; entries and exits require an actual ETH trade.
information_contract.rolling_features: Every beta, scale and activity observation ends strictly before the candidate shock start.

markets.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

research_question: Can a completed Bybit BTCUSDT event-time aggressive shock identify an economically large, still-unincorporated ETHUSDT response after explicit latency and 12/18/24bp round-trip costs?
